summary_en: ¥200/share annual (¥100 interim + ¥100 year-end), +60 yen vs. prior forecast (¥140). Interim raised from ¥70 to ¥100; year-end raised from ¥70 to ¥100. Progressive dividend policy underpinning future increases or maintenance.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of full-year consolidated earnings forecast and modification of interim and year-end dividend forecasts (increase)
translation_en_brief: Otsuka Holdings raised its full-year dividend forecast on 31 July 2026 following upward revision of consolidated earnings. The interim dividend (record date 30 June 2026) is increased from ¥70 to ¥100 per share, with total payout of ¥52.5 billion. The year-end dividend forecast is raised from ¥70 to ¥100 per share, bringing the annual total to ¥200 per share (¥100 interim + ¥100 year-end), an increase of ¥60 from the prior forecast of ¥140. The revision reflects strong first-half performance in the pharmaceutical and nutritional-care segments, including on-track launch progress for key growth drivers (Rexulti, Lonsurf, Voyxact) and delayed generic entry for certain products. The company maintains a progressive dividend policy of year-on-year increases or maintenance.
